title: SDK log archive export
prerequisites: SDK log directory determined for the actual SDK build and app container.
User explicitly requests export; app can write a temporary archive and present sharing UI.
sequence: Locate the SDK-created log directories rather than exporting only app console output.
Create a bounded archive in app-controlled storage, preserving encrypted SDK log contents.
Check archive creation succeeded and the expected entries are present.
Expose it through the platform sharing/file mechanism with scoped access.
Record SDK version and reproduction time separately; remove temporary exports according to app retention policy.
expected_result: Archive exists, is nonempty and contains SDK log entries.
checklist: Archive exists, is nonempty and contains SDK log entries.
A recipient can open the archive without needing app-private filesystem paths.
Missing directories and copy/zip failures are reported.
failure_handling: Do not place backend secrets or app configuration exports into the log archive.
Do not assume identical paths or permissions on Android and iOS.

platform_notes.android: The inspected exporter selects stageOneLogs and logs_mPower and shares a ZIP using FileProvider. Prefer app-controlled output and verify URI grants for the chosen Android target.
platform_notes.ios: LoggingModel archives Documents/logs_mPower using NSFileCoordinator with forUploading and moves the archive to a temporary location.

qualification.note: Inspected local source snapshots; revisions identify app sources, not mobile SDK releases. SDK artifacts must be qualified separately.

android.code:
// App pseudocode; resolve release-specific paths inside the app container.
val dirs = resolveSdkLogDirectories()
require(dirs.isNotEmpty())
val zip = archiveSdkLogs(dirs, appPrivateCacheDirectory)
require(zip.exists() && zip.length() > 0L)
val uri = fileProviderUri(zip)
shareZipWithTemporaryReadGrant(uri)
// Keep encrypted SDK logs intact; do not include config or credential files.
